scientific_integrity: Exact proof and independently replayable finite checker included; independent scientific validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification is restricted to eigenvectors inside the unperturbed minus-two flat-band space of cycle-flower line graphs.
No complete absorption probability or classification of all perturbed eigenvectors is claimed.
The iid disorder limit fixes alphabet size and odd loop length before the loop count grows.
Historical priority remains provisional; the full 1991 Mielke source could not be inspected.
title: Parity-selective protection of line-graph flat-band modes under discrete onsite disorder
